name: Northern Lights | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Ready-To-Use)
description:
DIAMONDS INSIDE 
Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market. 
— 
Northern Lights is a legendary indica known for its fast-acting, deeply relaxing effects that soothe both mind and body. With a sweet and spicy aroma, it's a favorite for evening use, offering a calm, euphoric experience. 
Citrus 
Pine 
Herbal
